slides.title: Multiple Inheritance Structure
slides.prompt: Multiple Inheritance allows a derived class to inherit from more than one base class. The Diamond Problem occurs when two base classes share a common parent.

slides.title: Multiple Inheritance Syntax
slides.prompt: Fill in the separator symbol for inheriting multiple base classes.
slides.codeSnippet: class Robot : public Device___ public AI {};

slides.title: Diamond Ambiguity Cause
slides.prompt: What causes ambiguity when accessing member 'x' in class D in a Diamond structure (D -> B, C -> A)?
options: Object D contains two copies of Base A (one via B, one via C)
Class A constructor runs after Class D destructor
VTable cannot store multiple base classes
slides.correctAnswer: Object D contains two copies of Base A (one via B, one via C)

slides.title: Virtual Base Class Keyword
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to solve the Diamond Problem by sharing a single base instance.
slides.codeSnippet:
class B : ___ public A {};
class C : ___ public A {};

slides.title: Virtual Base Constructor Responsibility
slides.prompt: In virtual inheritance, which class is responsible for initializing the shared virtual base class?
options: The most derived class (Class D directly)
slides.correctAnswer: The most derived class (Class D directly)

slides.title: Ambiguity Resolution Scope Operator
slides.prompt: Without virtual inheritance, resolve ambiguity manually using scope operator: d.___::x;

slides.title: Virtual Base Pointer Overhead
slides.prompt: How does virtual inheritance affect internal object memory layout?
options: Adds virtual base pointers (vbptr) to track shared base offset
Allocates shared base class on Heap dynamically
Combines all member variables into static storage
slides.correctAnswer: Adds virtual base pointers (vbptr) to track shared base offset

slides.title: Multiple Inheritance Base Order
slides.prompt: Base constructors execute in the order they appear in class ___.

slides.title: Interface-Only Multiple Inheritance
slides.prompt: Why is multiple inheritance of pure abstract interface classes considered safe?
options: Interface classes contain no member variables, avoiding diamond state ambiguity
Compiler converts interface inheritance to single inheritance
Interfaces are allocated in global data segment
slides.correctAnswer: Interface classes contain no member variables, avoiding diamond state ambiguity
